‘You are gay’: Tommy Robinson clashes with Nick Fuentes over his stance on Muslims
item.description: A new online spat has erupted between Tommy Robinson and American commentator Nick Fuentes. Fuentes accused Robinson of being a 'Zionist tool' used to provoke clashes in Britain and undermine pro-Palestinian demonstrations. Robinson hit back, dismissing the claims and questioning Fuentes' understanding of UK Muslim communities. The exchange has sparked varied reactions on social media.

COP30: How Brazilian crime cartels undermine climate efforts
item.description: As COP30 unfolds in Belem, environmental crimes linked to organized groups like Comando Vermelho are evident in the Amazon. These criminal enterprises, controlling illegal gold, timber, and drug trades, pose significant threats to the region's environment and population, hindering sustainable development.

Who is Jack Doherty? Popular YouTuber arrested in Florida after officers report drug charges
item.description: Popular YouTuber Jack Doherty was apprehended in Miami Beach after police discovered amphetamine and marijuana on his person. He faces charges including possession of a controlled substance, marijuana, and resisting arrest. Doherty, known for his viral flipping videos and large social media following, was taken to a correctional center. His bond was set at $3,500.

item.title: Candace Owens lists 10 TPUSA verifiable lies and raises big questions about Charlie Kirk’s assassination story
item.description: Candace Owens has revealed ten alleged lies spread by Turning Point USA following Charlie Kirk's assassination. Owens claims TPUSA fabricated stories to portray individuals as more heroic and loyal, altering facts about Kirk, his beliefs, and the incident. She vows to continue investigating, believing she is close to uncovering the truth.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: ‘Your mayor is a disaster’: Donald Trump renews attack on Sadiq Khan; questions London’s law and order
item.description: US President Donald Trump has renewed his criticism of London Mayor Sadiq Khan. Trump labelled Khan a "terrible mayor" and a "nasty person" during a recent interview. He cited rising crime in London and suggested Sharia Law operates in some areas. This ongoing dispute between Trump and Khan has persisted for years.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: What made Ludwig Ahgren’s charity stream so personal? Details behind the long-time fan who changed his life
item.description: Twitch streamer Ludwig Ahgren honored his late fan Kanabana, a member of the trans community, with a heartfelt tribute and a charity stream for The Trevor Project. Despite facing transphobic remarks from haters, Ahgren expressed frustration with the political climate fueling such hate, while fans continued their support for the cause.

item.title: ‘To protect national interests’: Iran seizes oil tanker in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran has confirmed seizing a Marshall Islands-flagged oil tanker, the Talara, in the Strait of Hormuz, citing an "illegal consignment" and a court order to protect national interests. The vessel, carrying petrochemical products, was taken to Iranian waters. This incident occurs amidst heightened regional tensions and Iran's history of maritime seizures.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'They are controllable': Indian-origin Howard professor explains 2 reasons why US companies prefer H-1Bs
item.description: Howard professor Ronil Hira explains why US companies favor H-1B visas, citing lower wages and employer control over foreign workers. He highlights incidents where American workers trained their H-1B replacements, suggesting many H-1B holders possess ordinary, not necessarily high, skills. Hira emphasizes H-1B is a labor policy with weak worker protections, making it attractive to employers.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Make America Grate Again: Trump v MTG in epic MAGA maelstrom after she tries to maim H1b visas
item.description: Donald Trump publicly attacked Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene, calling her "wacky" and accusing her of moving left. Greene retaliated, suggesting her push to release Epstein files and opposition to H1B visas angered Trump. This public spat highlights growing divisions within the MAGA movement, with Greene defiant and Trump threatening political repercussions.
item.dc:creator: Chidanand Rajghatta

item.title: What really happened between FaZe Lacy and Valkyrae during Sisathon stream? Inside the controversy stirring up the streaming world
item.description: Streamer FaZe Lacy is facing backlash for using the R-slur during Valkyrae's subathon. His initial apology, where he stated he was "re*arded when I said it," was met with criticism. Lacy later apologized again, citing respect for friends Valkyrae and Cinna, but the controversy persists.

item.title: ‘Black women can’t swim because of societal expectations’: Michelle Obama’s viral claim sparks controversy
item.description: Michelle Obama's recent comment about societal hair expectations contributing to Black women avoiding swimming has gone viral. She explained that the effort to maintain straightened hair, which can be undone by water, leads some to skip water-based activities. The remark sparked widespread mockery and debate on social media.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Crazy fearmongering': Indian-Malaysian CEO Vishen Lakhiani says he was stopped by FBI agents at Miami airport because...
item.description: Vishen Lakhiani, an Indian-Malaysian CEO on an O-1 visa, was questioned by FBI agents upon arriving in Miami. He was asked about his international travel and social media presence. Lakhiani expressed concern over xenophobia and fearmongering impacting tourism and foreign student applications in the US. The O-1 visa holder said he can't wait for the next US election.
